    "C25-R2-F1 — C25-F2/G2 remains partially unresolved. Explicit per-call row tags remove blanket family credit, but crates/xtask/src/live_academy.rs:261 still passes every call solely on result.kind=data and discards the hosted result values needed to judge behavior. For example, progress.checkInline records no grading verdict, and progress.resetCourse plus progress.courseSummary record no before/after progress or certificate-preservation assertion. W53 is represented by catalog/eligibility/certificate/status reads; W65 by daily/board/history/eligibility reads, rather than the required interactive workflows. D055 withdraws explicit lab submission, not these other requirements. Add operation-specific redacted assertions and state/readback evidence for the remaining approved scope; reconcile the interactive W53/W65 coverage with the live matrix, or record an actual owner-approved narrowing. Acceptance: arbitrary data, an unchanged/incorrect reset result and an incorrect grading response cannot pass; the receipts demonstrate the expected hosted outcomes, and reads cannot close unexecuted state transitions."
  ],
  "blockers": [],
  "evidence_gaps": [
    "C25-R2-G1 — Current Academy receipts still expose only result=data, with failure/http_status/outcome null. W53/W65 interactive coverage is not supplied by the listed read procedures. The expanded call list and row tags improve attribution but do not close the remaining C25-F2/G2 behavioral evidence gap."
  ],
  "optional_suggestions": [],
  "limitations": [
    "Independent read-only re-review. No application/source changes, builds, test reruns, application launches, product endpoint calls or credential access. Only this verdict is written. Runtime conclusions rely on inspected implementation/tests and verified public/redacted recorded evidence, not fresh reproductions. The private execution manifest and credential values were not read.",
    "C25-F1 is resolved in the inspected implementation. Program calls now debit Guard::spend before dispatch; avatar upload/removal reserve two calls before either request. Exhaustion records a blocked outcome and stops the run. The executed fixture regression verifies the next call is not sent after exhaustion, and receipt counters now reflect admitted spend. C25-F3 is also resolved: the recorded plan executes the previously missing runner and affected core integration suites.",
    "C25-F4 is resolved with implementation bindings and a verified carry-forward. All 100 current live receipts and the run record name source 3df30f29f163e8330e3f7b3b15aea803897a66df9fd226806d02362cd040a08d, the current Cargo.lock hash and one recorded runner hash. Without writing files, I reconstructed that source fingerprint exactly by substituting only the two documented earlier file contents: production comments and a DLP test expectation. This supports carry-forward to the final tree; the original producer binary was not independently rerun.",
    "Recorded D055 explicitly defers L16 and the Harness-run L17 call/approval/denial/refresh cases to C26, waives the inactive profile cleanup, and withdraws W56's explicit live lab submit. The reconciliation log now records the cleanup waiver. These resolve the earlier C25-B1/B2 and corresponding scope gaps for this review; they do not establish that deferred checks passed or that the profile was removed. D052/D053 reductions and D054's SDK 0.2.4 direction remain accounted for.",
    "All four supplied fingerprints independently match. Verified 754 source entries, 488 direct packet references, exact command plans, command logs/artifacts, shared dependency equivalence and 33 transitive receipt bindings. Recorded plans pass 13 check/setup commands, 12 test/setup commands and 3 native-preparation commands.",
    "Recorded tests include 425 desktop frontend and 224 core unit tests, 13 manifest tests, 37 live-runner integration tests and 14 xtask unit tests. The affected core targets pass: runtime_changes 16, dlp_subset 10, gateway_inference 18, academy_identity 22, academy_learner 7, academy_offline 32 and context_credentials 44. Counts overlap and do not prove the remaining live assertions above.",
    "The latest live directory contains 100 receipts: 90 passed, 7 blocked and 3 native-app-required, across two execution-manifest hashes. L16 remains absent under the recorded deferral. Recorded charges total L01 scans 14, L18 scans 16, L09 runs 39/tokens 124, L12 calls 16 and L13 calls 11. These are ledger totals, not independently observed service consumption.",
    "All four C25 native checks still report pass against executable 1266b95a5e6663610b9375bcc77d681f46cc4a14383a676c24b994ec1f3bc637. The product changes after the live run are comments only; the other carry-forward edit is a test expectation. Spoken VoiceOver was not exercised. Cached Gateway answers without finish_reason remain a disclosed SDK follow-up; successful L09 checks use uncached prompts. Signed Harness/package, notarization and installed-artifact qualification remain C26/P08 gates."
  ],
